[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

## Prompt



```text
Restore this low-resolution image. Preserve its drawing style, colors, and composition. Clean up noisy areas and improve clarity without adding new objects or invented surface details.
```

## Required inputs

- A low-resolution source image.

## Notes

- Concise English adaptation of the creator’s Japanese prompt. Restoration can invent details; compare the result against the original.

[Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com) and paste the prompt into the appropriate image workflow. This link currently opens the homepage and does not prefill the prompt. GIF and file-export recipes need additional processing tools.
